description_excerpt: Ajax Systems, an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe. We are looking for an experienced Lead CCTV Industrialization Engineer and NPI Expert with broad hands-on expertise in electronic, mechanical, and optical product development, manufacturing introduction, validation, and production testing. The key objective of this role is to share practical expertise across R&D, NPI, and Manufacturing, to build up proper CCTV manufacturing processes, ecosystem, and lines to maximize throughput and efficiency. A mandatory requirement is substantial…
benefits: The opportunity to suggest and implement your own ideas that directly influence the product and its mass production
A place in a fast-growing company with a motivated and professional team
The opportunity to participate in Ajax’s internal beta-testing program for security systems
